title: "w04_Task1"
---


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
```

```{r}
df <- read_rds("https://github.com/byuistats/data/raw/master/Dart_Expert_Dow_6month_anova/Dart_Expert_Dow_6month_anova.RDS")
View(df)
```

```{r}
firstsep <- separate(df, contest_period, sep = "-",
 into = c("Beginning Month-Year", "Ending Month-Year"), remove = TRUE)
```

```{r}
secondsep <- separate(firstsep, "Ending Month-Year", sep =  "(?=\\d{4}$)", into = c("MonthEnd", "YearEnd"), remove = TRUE) %>% 
    select(-"Beginning Month-Year") 

View(secondsep)
```

```{r}
write_rds(secondsep, "secondsep.rds")
```

```{r}
newdf <- read_rds("secondsep.RDS")

newdf
```

```{r}
DJIA <- filter(newdf, variable == "DJIA") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = YearEnd, values_from = value) %>% 
  arrange(match(MonthEnd, month.name))

DJIA

```
